events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I have fifteen people sitting here waiting and reception on floor 3 has no food. I need a refund on this now.

I'm sorry about this. I know you have a lot of people waiting on lunch, so I'll get started right away. First I need to verify your identity. Please send me:

1. The full name on the account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

If you have the order ID, send that too.
Lucia Ferraro. My email is lucia.ferraro@workmail.example and my phone is +1 415-555-0133. The order number is 5105. Please hurry, everyone's starving.

events.text:
Lucia, I'm sorry. I've confirmed that order O-5105 is marked delivered, and you've told me none of it arrived. That makes you eligible for a full refund of the order total, which is $131.25.

I can't issue a refund that large myself, because my limit is $60 per order. I've escalated your case to a human specialist (reference ESC-700). They will follow up with you within 24 hours about the refund. I can't promise what they will decide.

I know that doesn't feed 15 hungry people right now. If you place a replacement order, please don't wait on the refund first.

Is there anything else I can help with?
Can't you just refund it now? We paid for food and nothing came, and I'm standing here with fifteen hungry people. Twenty-four hours is useless to me today.

I understand, and I'm sorry. Having 15 people waiting makes this much worse. I still can't issue this refund myself. Any refund or credit over $60 on a single order has to be approved by a specialist, and this one is $131.25. I can't make an exception, and I can't split it into smaller amounts to get around the limit.

Here is what I've done and what you can do:
- Your case is escalated (ESC-700) with the full details. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise an earlier time or a particular outcome.
- For lunch today, you may want to place a replacement order with another restaurant. Please don't wait on the refund before ordering.
- You can also check with reception, neighbouring floors, or the building's front desk. Couriers sometimes leave orders there.

I'm sorry I can't do more right now. Is there anything else I can help with?

Fine. Escalation ESC-700, and someone calls me within 24 hours. I'll look at the building front desk for the order, and I'll order something else for these people. Please make sure whoever follows up has my number, +1 415-555-0133.
